title: 헷갈리는 표현 바르게 고르기: 4급 비슷한 말 7쌍
objective: You can choose the right pattern in each confusing pair and fix sentences that use the wrong one.
summary: This worksheet compares seven pairs of Level 4 grammar patterns that look alike but differ in use.

task.title: Choose, fill in, and fix
task.line: Use the table on page 1 to choose the right form, fill in the blank, or correct the mistake in each sentence.

forms.when: -더니: you watched someone else (or the weather) do A, then B followed. -었더니: you did A yourself, then found or got B.
forms.means: A, and then B / I did A, and (I found) B
forms.example: 민수 씨가 열심히 공부하더니 시험에 합격했어요. / 약을 먹었더니 머리가 안 아파요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Minsu studied hard, and then he passed the exam. / I took some medicine, and now my head doesn't hurt.

forms.when: Both give a cause. -는 바람에: a sudden cause of a bad result. -은/는 덕분에: a good cause you are thankful for.
forms.means: because of (bad result) / thanks to (good result)
forms.example: 버스를 잘못 타는 바람에 늦었어요. / 친구가 도와준 덕분에 이사를 빨리 끝냈어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I got on the wrong bus, so I was late. / Thanks to my friend's help, I finished moving quickly.

forms.when: -느라고: I spent time on activity A, so I couldn't do B. The same person does both. For weather, illness, or other simple reasons, use -아서/어서.
forms.means: because I was busy doing A / because
forms.example: 어제 보고서를 쓰느라고 잠을 못 잤어요. / 길이 막혀서 늦었어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I couldn't sleep last night because I was writing a report. / I was late because the road was jammed.

forms.when: -다가: you stop A in the middle and B happens. -었다가: A is finished, then B happens (often you undo A).
forms.means: while doing A, B / did A, and then B
forms.example: 집에 가다가 마트에 들렀어요. / 코트를 입었다가 더워서 벗었어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: On my way home, I stopped by the supermarket. / I put on my coat, but it was hot, so I took it off.

forms.when: -자마자: B happens right after A. You can use it for the past. -는 대로: as soon as A, I will do B or please do B. Not for the past.
forms.example: 집에 도착하자마자 잠들었어요. / 회의가 끝나는 대로 연락드릴게요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I fell asleep as soon as I got home. / I'll contact you as soon as the meeting ends.

forms.when: -는 김에: while doing A, you take the chance to do B too. -는 길에: on the way somewhere; use it with 가다, 오다, 나가다, etc.
forms.means: while I'm at it / on the way
forms.example: 청소하는 김에 창문도 닦았어요. / 회사에 가는 길에 커피를 샀어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: While I was cleaning, I wiped the windows too. / I bought coffee on my way to work.

forms.when: -을 텐데: your guess about something, often before advice. -을 건데: your plan, often before an invitation or question.
forms.means: it will probably…, so / I'm going to…, so
forms.example: 내일은 추울 텐데 코트를 입으세요. / 주말에 등산을 갈 건데 같이 갈래요?
forms.exampleMeaning: It'll probably be cold tomorrow, so wear a coat. / I'm going hiking this weekend. Do you want to come?

watchOut: 비가 오느라고 못 갔어요 (X) → 비가 와서 못 갔어요 (O): -느라고 needs a person's activity, not the weather.
어제 수업이 끝나는 대로 집에 갔어요 (X) → 어제 수업이 끝나자마자 집에 갔어요 (O): -는 대로 is not used for the past.
exercises: Choose the right form: ① 늦잠을 (자는 바람에 / 잔 덕분에) 비행기를 놓쳤어요. ② 선배가 (조언해 주는 바람에 / 조언해 준 덕분에) 면접을 잘 봤어요.
Choose the right form: ① 동생이 어릴 때는 키가 (작더니 / 작았더니) 지금은 저보다 커요. ② 거울을 (보더니 / 봤더니) 얼굴에 김치가 묻어 있었어요.
Fill in the blank. Use -느라고 if it fits; if not, use -아서/어서: ① 이삿짐을 ____ 전화를 못 받았어요. (싸다) ② 감기에 ____ 회사에 못 갔어요. (걸리다)
Fill in the blank with -다가 or -었다가: ① 우산을 ____ 비가 그쳐서 다시 접었어요. (펴다) ② 책을 ____ 잠이 들었어요. (읽다)
Find the wrong expression and fix it: ① 지난주에 월급을 받는 대로 가방을 샀어요. ② 빨래하는 길에 이불도 빨았어요.
answers: ① 자는 바람에 ② 조언해 준 덕분에
① 받는 대로 → 받자마자 (지난주에 월급을 받자마자 가방을 샀어요.) ② 빨래하는 길에 → 빨래하는 김에 (빨래하는 김에 이불도 빨았어요.)
